captions.detailed: A professional-scale speedlight camera flash rendered in a matte black finish. It features a rectangular lower battery housing with a distinct battery door panel on one side, a tall neck mount, and a wide rectangular flash head with rounded side cheeks. The neck swivels continuously on a vertical axis above the body, and the flash head rotates on a horizontal tilt hinge supported by an exposed cradle geometry.
captions.instruction: Generate a CAD model of a professional camera speedlight. The model should include a rectangular main battery body with a separate side battery door panel, a rotating neck support, and a rectangular flash head with rounded cheeks. Ensure the neck can swivel continuously on the vertical axis and the head can tilt on a horizontal hinge.
captions.factory: The speedlight is constructed using multiple parts and joints. The main body is built from a box primitive, with a thin box boolean cut or offset to create the distinct battery door panel. The neck is formed from a cylinder base combined with a U-shaped cradle (constructed via box and cylinder booleans). The flash head is modeled as a box with filleted edges for the rounded cheeks. A continuous rotary joint connects the body to the neck, while a revolute joint connects the neck cradle to the flash head.
